name: Den', kotoryj zabral tebja
source:
Set in a medieval fantasy world, an era filled with magic and dangers at every step. The main protagonist, Nicole, discovers her magical abilities and falls deeply in love with a simple guy from the neighboring town.

As a natural cataclysm divides the Empire into two parts, enmity erupts between the peoples, and the heroes find themselves on opposite sides. The rift in the universe echoes the rift in Nicole's heart. She realizes that she will never see her beloved again. Or will she have a chance to turn back time? Is it worth chasing the initial feelings, sacrificing the destinies of her loved ones, or accept her fate?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在一個充滿魔法的中世紀奇幻世界，危險隨處可見。妮可發現自己擁有魔法天賦，也深深愛上了鄰鎮的一個普通男孩。

一場天災把帝國分成兩半。兩地的人們反目成仇，兩人也被隔在了對立的兩邊。天地間的裂痕彷彿也撕開了妮可的心。她明白，自己再也見不到戀人了。可如果還有機會讓時間倒流呢？為了追尋最初的心動，值得拿親友的命運當代價嗎？還是該接受自己的命運？

（來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234690/]Steam[/url]）
